node.title: Re^5: sequential substitutions
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: In regards to pretty-printing XML/HTML, if I'm writing it by hand, I take care to write it cleanly, and if I'm generating it with a module, if I need it to be human-readable, usually those modules have options to format it (e.g. [mod://XML::LibXML::Document] has ->toString(1) or ->toFile($filename, 1)). Other than that, many IDE's have built-in pretty-printers (when I was coding more Java, I used Eclipse a lot, it's also good for editing/formatting XML).
